label: 开发排名出现后的 readout 发现性诊断
timing: Post hoc: selected after V1 independent ranking showed readout ahead of full and RW. Does not replace the original full primary or original four contrasts.
primary_statistic: Equal market/year/horizon mean of seed-average native squared error divided by same-cell RW MSE.
bootstrap: Synchronous paired circular calendar blocks by year, 42 days and prespecified 84-day sensitivity, B=20000, seed20261019. Average seed losses within each origin first. Recompute RW denominator per bootstrap replicate.
intervals: Marginal 95% and 97.5% two-comparison Bonferroni intervals. The latter addresses only these two contrasts, not post-selection of readout or prior searches.
evidence_limit: Exploratory development finding; no fresh confirmation and no publication guarantee.
